service.name: Dawntrail Extreme Trials Bundle
service.longDescription: All seven Dawntrail Extremes in one package — from the Skyruin’s tempest to Necron’s final stand, with the Wings of Legacy guaranteed along the way. Piloted or AFK, your totems and mounts included.

rewards.title: All 7 Extreme Trials
rewards.text: Every trial cleared in one package — pick the ones you need or take them all.

rewards.title: Trial Totems
rewards.text: Totems from every clear, exchangeable for mounts and gear.

rewards.title: Mount Guaranteed Option
rewards.text: One run with every trial checked guarantees the Wings of Legacy at its own price.

rewards.title: Achievements Unlocked
rewards.text: Every Extreme trial achievement on completion.

items: Trials unlocked (available as an additional service)
